lines.text: Would you give a wrong answer just because everyone else did?
Students had to say which of three lines matched a fourth.
Everyone else in the room was an actor, giving the same wrong answer.
Tested alone, almost nobody got it wrong.
In the group, about three in four went along at least once.
Verdict: it wasn't their eyes. It was the room.
Next time you're the odd one out, say what you see.

post.title: Would You Give a Wrong Answer to Fit In? #shorts
post.description: In Solomon Asch's line studies (1951), people judging line lengths alone almost never erred (under 1%), but with a group of actors all giving the same wrong answer, about three in four went along at least once. That's conformity. #psychology #socialpsychology #conformity
